🌟 homebox | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Home inventory and organization management.
✨ Key Features: • Rich Organization (categories, locations, tags, custom fields) • Powerful Search • Image Upload • Document and Warranty Tracking • Purchase & Maintenance Tracking
📖 Summary: HomeBox is a Go-based inventory and organization system designed for home users, prioritizing simplicity, speed, and portability. It offers features like categorization, powerful search, image uploads, and document tracking, all accessible via an embedded web UI and deployable with minimal resources.
